published.title: Appointment of Director to the Metro Vancouver Regional District Board of Directors
published.resolution_text: THAT the appointment of Mayor Linda Buchanan (Director) and Councillor Angela Girard (Alternate Director) as the City of North Vancouver representatives to the Metro Vancouver Regional District Board of Directors, for the 4-year term of Council, be endorsed.
published.summary: Endorsed the mayor as the City's director and a councillor as alternate director on the Metro Vancouver Regional District board for the four-year council term.

published.title: 2027 Council Appointments to Statutory, Management and Advisory Committees
published.resolution_text:
PURSUANT to the report of the Director, Legislative Services and Corporate Officer, dated October 28, 2026, entitled “2027 Council Appointments to Statutory, Management and Advisory Committees”:
THAT the 2027 Council Appointments to Statutory, Management and Advisory Committees for November 3, 2026 to December 31, 2027 be endorsed, as presented.
published.summary: Endorsed the list of councillors' appointments to statutory, management and advisory committees for November 3, 2026 to December 31, 2027.

published.title: Results of the General Local Election Held in the City of North Vancouver on October 17, 2026
published.resolution_text:
PURSUANT to the report of the Chief Election Officer, dated October 21, 2026, entitled “Results of the General Local Election Held in the City of North Vancouver on October 17, 2026”:
THAT the Certificate of the Chief Election Officer, dated October 21, 2026, containing the results of the General Local Election (Mayor, Councillors, and School Trustees), held in the City of North Vancouver on October 17, 2026, be received and recorded in full in the Minutes.
published.summary: Received the Chief Election Officer's certificate of the October 17, 2026 election results for mayor, councillors and school trustees and recorded it in the minutes.

published.title: Appointment of Auditors for 2026 to 2030
published.resolution_text:
PURSUANT to the report of the Chief Financial Officer, dated October 28, 2026, entitled “Appointment of Auditors for 2026 to 2030”:
THAT MNP LLP be appointed as auditors for the City of North Vancouver for the fiscal years 2026 to 2030.
published.summary: Appointed MNP LLP as the City of North Vancouver's auditors for the fiscal years 2026 to 2030.

published.title: Service Standards and Public Reporting for Building Permits and Business Licences
published.summary: Directed staff to report by mid-2027 on building permit and business licence processing times, proposed service standards, application tracking and public performance reporting.
